verdict_excerpt:
/panel-llms run 14 Nov 2026 (second run of the day) on a four-line correction to public/llms-full.txt that mirrors wording already live on the site pages. Owner approval given in chat: "Yes, approve and deploy".
Change: line 1057 "The imported brands are rebadged" becomes "Most of the imported brands are rebadged" (matches uk-steel-doors-vs-imported). Blog Excerpts entry for front-door-security-ratings-compared-sr1-to-sr3 regenerated with scripts/blog/backfill-llms-full.mjs: the "SR3 and RC3 are identical" FAQ answer is replaced by the corrected answer (SR is LPS 1175, RC is BS EN 1627, not interchangeable); the "(commonly referred to as SR1 through SR6)" bracket is removed; one key fact dropped by the five-bullet cap.
Deep review: APPROVE WITH FIXES, keep every line. All changed lines match their source word for word; no brand rule broken. HIGH finding: the corrected key fact now sits beside the pre-existing false line "All legitimate door security ratings in the UK and Europe are defined by BS EN 1627:2011" (blog post line 22); fix belongs in the post, not this diff. Also open: post lines 32 and 134, imports page answer mixing the schemes, "six to eight weeks in manufacture" at llms-full 816, 828, 1065 against "around six" on the page.
Live AI test (Google AI Mode, DuckDuckGo Assist, Bing Copilot 15 queries each; Brave 3): the old wording is still surfaced from stale copies of the pages by Google AI Mode and Brave; Brave answered that SR3 and RC3 are the same. Primary sources reported by the reviewer: LPS 1175 Issue 8.2 foreword and the BRE facade guide say the schemes do not correlate.
Visibility: organic proxy positions unchanged since the morning baseline; Gerda pages not surfacing. Cannibalisation: only pair above 40% is Thermo Premium and Thermo Prime at 45.9%; today's rewording moved no figure by more than 0.12 points.
Not tested: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity (sign-in or key), Serper (no credits), Brave beyond 3 queries (bot check).
